reading_evidence.scope: Complete proofs of Lemmas 10.153.2 and 10.153.9, together with the defining simple-root formulation in 10.153.1.
reading_evidence.application: Apply to T^m-1. Since p does not divide m, the derivative mT^(m-1) is nonzero at every residue mth root. Uniqueness makes the lift multiplicative because the product of two lifted roots is the unique lift of the product.
